name: Hime to En'yoku no Imperium
original_name: 姫と艶欲のインペリウム
source:
Feared as the "Warlock of Destruction," Lucius, the protagonist, once unleashed chaos upon the world with his immense power. Defeated at the hands of the Hero and sealed away, Lucius would awaken once more after a thousand years of slumber.

The catalyst for his awakening was Irena, the first princess of the Noxheim Empire - a nation that dominated the continent with its military strength and advanced technology. 

Sensing that an unknown power within Irena had roused him, Lucius plotted to make use of it to restore his diminished strength and lost memories to complete his return. However, as an imperial princess and a descendant of the Hero, Irena rejected Lucius, refusing to align with the "Warlock of Destruction." To force Irena into undoing the seal, Lucius began a ritual intended to lay her heart bare and bring her under his control through humiliation and pleasure.

What drove Lucius to become the "Warlock of Destruction" a millennium ago?
Why does Irena hold the power to unseal Lucius?

The warlock of a thousand years past and the imperial princess. Their encounter would entangle the schemes and ambitions of many, and ultimately reveal the empire's hidden truths...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/world.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角卢修斯被誉为“毁灭术士”，曾经凭借强大的力量给世界带来了混乱。卢修斯败在英雄手中并被封印，沉睡了一千年后再次苏醒。

促使他觉醒的催化剂是诺克斯海姆帝国的第一公主伊琳娜——这个国家以军事实力和先进科技称霸大陆。

卢修斯察觉到伊琳娜体内有一股未知的力量唤醒了自己，他密谋利用它来恢复自己减弱的力量和失去的记忆，完成回归。然而，身为帝国公主和英雄后裔的伊蕾娜拒绝了卢修斯，拒绝与“毁灭术士”结盟。为了迫使伊琳娜解开封印，卢修斯开始了一场仪式，旨在揭露她的内心，并通过羞辱和快乐将她置于他的控制之下。

是什么让卢修斯成为千年前的“毁灭术士”？
为什么伊蕾娜拥有解封卢修斯的力量？

一千年前的术士与帝国公主。他们的遭遇将纠缠许多人的阴谋和野心，并最终揭露帝国隐藏的真相……

[翻译自[url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/world.html]官网[/url]]
